latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the product-requirement-delivery skill.

- Converts lightweight product requests and related signed-in pages into a confirmed requirements baseline, published as a single Feishu document.
- Guides the full workflow: auditing intake, real-page investigation (with screenshots and permission checks), drafting, review, product confirmation, and Feishu publication.
- Enforces non-negotiable gates on roles, permissions, business flows, exceptions, and auditability; ensures every business rule and acceptance criterion is clear and evidenced.
- Prevents publication before explicit product manager confirmation; preserves rigorous distinction between observed, user-stated, recommended, and unverified facts.
- No development or test plans produced; focus is on product requirements baseline and audit trail.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Enables browser automation for Chinese domestic sites using the real logged-in state of the local Chrome browser.

- Automates operations and data extraction for sites like Xiaohongshu, Taobao/Tmall, WeChat, Weibo, Bilibili, 12306, Zhihu, and SaaS backends.
- Reuses the session of the user’s own Chrome via remote debugging (CDP), avoiding redundant logins and bypassing common anti-bot/login barriers.
- Includes site-specific templates, selectors, and anti-crawling suggestions for major platforms.
- Provides scripts for direct data extraction and export to JSON/CSV, with verified selectors for key sites.
- Emphasizes compliance: limits usage to the user’s authorized accounts/data and does not include automated CAPTCHA/verification code solving.

items.summary: Query the list of Huawei Cloud BMS (Bare Metal Server) instances under the current tenant / project, focused on the BMS NAME list. Returns each server's name, id and status; can also output a pure BMS name-only list. Supports filtering by status, name and pagination (limit/offset). Uses the KooCLI command `hcloud BMS ListBareMetalServers --cli-region={region}` (primary) against the v1 API, or the huaweicloudsdkbms Python SDK (fallback). Read-only — never creates, modifies or deletes any bare metal server. Use this skill whenever the user wants to list/inspect the BMS instances of the tenant or query the BMS name list, e.g. for BMS inventory, daily inspection, or cost review. Triggers include: "list BMS", "BMS list", "query BMS names", "BMS name list", "裸金属服务器列表", "查询裸金属服务器", "BMS名称列表", "裸金属服务器名称", "list bare metal servers", "how many BMS".
